preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of input strings must be exactly 2n - 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= n - 1 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each input string must have a length between 1 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length of 2n - 2.
The output string must contain an equal number of 'P' and 'S' characters, each being n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'PS' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must only consist of characters 'P' and 'S'.
